notes.title: 2024.12.05 Minor Update
notes.content:
- Added WR-GPX pixel art objects and investigation events in Chapter 1 Lounge (Tumblbug sponsor reward event)
- Localized some pixel art images in the Detective's Notebook
- Fixed an issue where dialogue could be skipped using the spacebar and enter key while the Detective's Notebook or Options menu was open
- Fixed an issue where the NG button would be disabled when deactivating the CUT function in the Deduction Theater

notes.title: English version now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Update - November 15, 2024[/h1]


[b]New Feature[/b]
- [b]English version[/b] now available!

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Resolved an issue where blank spaces could be submitted in the evidence presentation mini-game
- Fixed a problem where the intro skip guide UI appeared when clicking on the loading screen
- Addressed the issue of dot images not disappearing during multiple-choice questions
- Corrected a bug where the guide UI remained visible after the timer ended in multiple-choice questions if the player remained silent
- Fixed a dialogue sequencing issue in Chapter 1 conversation with Chae Hee-bi, where responses appeared in order regardless of player choices
